svg.title: Light bending by a Schwarzschild black hole
svg.desc: Photon paths for several impact parameters around a Schwarzschild black hole and the deflection angle against impact parameter.
svg.text: Photons around a Schwarzschild hole: u'' + u = 3 M u^2
Impact parameter b in units of M; shadow radius b_c = 3 sqrt(3) = 5.196. Rays with b < b_c are captured.
dashed: shadow edge b_c; dotted: photon sphere; filled: horizon 2M
